title: Subscriptions
description: Track recurring payments and see your monthly subscription total.
steps: Open the Subscriptions tab
Tap Add
Enter name, amount, and billing frequency
Optionally enable reminders
tips: Enable reminders so renewals do not surprise you.
Use reports to see subscription spend over time.

title: Budgets
description: Set spending limits by category and track how much is left.
steps: Open Reports or Dashboard budget section
Create a budget for a category
Choose period (weekly, monthly, or yearly)
Watch remaining amount update as you spend
tips: Start with your top spending categories.
Review budgets at the start of each month.

title: Goals
description: Create savings goals and track progress toward a target amount.
steps: Open the Goals tab
Tap Add
Set target amount and optional deadline
Link contributions from transactions or add manually
tips: Small regular contributions beat occasional large ones.

title: Backup
description: Back up your local data so you can restore it later.
steps: Open Settings
Go to Backup
Connect Google Drive if needed
Create a backup or enable auto-backup
tips: Run a backup before switching phones.
Keep auto-backup on if you want hands-free protection.

title: Restore backup
description: Restore your finances from a previous backup file.
steps: Open Settings → Backup
Choose Restore
Select a backup from Google Drive or a local file
Confirm restore and wait for completion
tips: Restoring may replace current local data. Back up first if unsure.

title: Where your data is stored
description: Your financial data stays on your device. Backend is used for auth, profile, sync helpers, and knowledge content—not your transactions.
steps: Add accounts and transactions in the app
Data is saved in the on-device database
Optional backups go to your Google Drive when you enable them
tips: You control backups. Clear app data removes local finances.

title: Notification reading
description: SaveMonei can read bank or UPI notifications on your device to suggest pending transactions.
steps: Open Settings → Auto detection / Notifications
Grant notification access when prompted
Confirm or edit suggested transactions from the dashboard
tips: You always confirm before a transaction is saved.

title: Permissions
description: Camera is used for receipts; notification access is optional for auto-detection; storage/Drive for backups.
steps: Grant only the permissions you need
Change them anytime in system Settings → Apps → SaveMonei
tips: You can use the app without notification reading.

title: Reports
description: See income, expenses, and category breakdowns for any date range.
steps: Open the Reports tab
Pick a date range or preset
Explore categories, accounts, and trends
tips: Compare this month vs last month to spot changes early.

title: Net worth
description: Net worth is your assets minus liabilities across accounts included in the calculation.
steps: Add accounts with balances
Mark liability accounts such as credit cards and loans correctly
Check net worth on the Dashboard
tips: Exclude accounts from net worth in account settings if needed.

title: Loans
description: Track loan balances, EMIs, and payment progress.
steps: Add a loan account or loan record
Enter principal, rate, and tenure if available
Record payments as you go
tips: Ask the assistant for your loan balance anytime.

title: Accounts
description: Accounts hold balances for banks, cash, cards, and other wallets.
steps: Open Accounts
Tap Add
Choose type and starting balance
Use them when recording transactions
tips: Keep credit cards as liability accounts for accurate net worth.

title: Transactions
description: Record income, expenses, and transfers against your accounts.
steps: Tap Add on Transactions (or use the camera for a receipt)
Choose type, amount, category, and account
Save
tips: Add a note or merchant to make search and reports clearer.

title: Export
description: Export your data for spreadsheets or personal records.
steps: Open Settings
Choose Export
Pick the format and share or save the file
tips: Export regularly if you keep offline archives.

title: Recurring transactions
description: Set up repeating income or expenses so upcoming bills stay visible.
steps: Create a recurring transaction or subscription
Choose frequency and next date
Review upcoming items on the Dashboard
tips: Recurring items power upcoming bills and cash-flow hints.
